faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Have questions? Here are the questions clients often ask about Go Space.

left.question: What is Go Space?
left.answer: Go Space is a virtual office service that helps businesses look professional with a strategic address for legal, branding, and operational needs.

left.question: Are meeting rooms available?
left.answer: Yes! You can book a meeting room anytime based on your needs, complete with supporting facilities.

left.question: Can I use VO if my business is not legally established yet?
left.answer: Go Space by Ganesha Consulting also provides business establishment services such as CV, PT, and more alongside Virtual Office rental.

right.question: How do I book?
right.answer: Booking can be done through our website by choosing the right package, filling out the registration form, and completing payment online.

right.question: Can I rent for more than 1 year?
right.answer: Of course! We offer annual rental packages, including multi-year rental options with special pricing.

right.question: What happens to unused meeting room quota after the rental period ends?
right.answer: If the rental period ends, remaining meeting room quota can no longer be used. Make sure to renew your rental to keep enjoying our services.
